settings.config_dir.label: Config directory
settings.config_dir.description: Where input-remapper keeps presets/ and config.json. Default for version 2.x is ~/.config/input-remapper-2.
settings.control_cmd.label: Control command
settings.control_cmd.description: The executable used to talk to the daemon. Leave as input-remapper-control unless you need a wrapper such as 'sudo -n input-remapper-control'. Inserted unquoted, so it may contain arguments.
settings.poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.poll_seconds.description: How often the preset list is rescanned and the daemon is pinged.
settings.hide_empty_devices.label: Hide devices without presets
settings.hide_empty_devices.description: Skip preset folders that contain no .json files.
settings.on_startup.label: On Noctalia start
settings.on_startup.description: What to do with the injection state remembered from the previous session.
settings.detect_connected.label: Detect connected devices
settings.detect_connected.description: Read /proc/bus/input/devices to split the list into Connected and Saved. Turn off to show every preset folder in one list.
settings.scroll_height.label: Scroll area height (0 = automatic)
settings.scroll_height.description: Leave at 0 to let the list take whatever space is left below the header. Set a pixel value only if the footer buttons get pushed off the bottom of the panel.
settings.debug_log.label: Write a debug log
settings.debug_log.description: Append diagnostics to debug.log in this plugin's data directory. Useful while troubleshooting; turn off once things are stable.
settings.show_label.label: Show preset name in the bar
settings.show_label.description: When exactly one injection is running, print its preset name next to the glyph.
settings.max_label_chars.label: Maximum label length
settings.max_label_chars.description: Preset names longer than this are truncated in the bar.

panel.no_devices_hint: Nothing under presets/ in the configured directory. Check the plugin settings, or create a preset in input-remapper first.
